presentation.scope: last 1800 samples per series; milliseconds and game pixels

bandwidth.measurement: Local outgoing + incoming logical JSON, once per direction. P2P includes kind/data; LAN outgoing includes POST envelope, incoming is SSE data. Excludes fragmentation, headers, signaling, retransmissions; POST counts submissions, P2P counts fully queued messages. Decimal MB; relay is a payload-only estimate.
